arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Dvoretzky argued that ordinary grammar treats and as a simple conjunction.
He stated that the defendant must lack all three traits to be ineligible.
Mr. Liu countered that and distributes the negative phrase across three conditions.
He argued that the context confirms the distributive meaning of the word.
